## ValueTypeConstructors.enumeration() method

A closed enum of string `members`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
enumeration<const Members extends readonly [string, ...string[]]>(members: Members, options?: ValueTypeOptions): ValueType<Members[number]>;
```

**Returns:**

[ValueType](./contracts.valuetype.md)<!-- -->&lt;Members\[number\]&gt;

## Exceptions

`TypeError` when `members` is empty or has duplicates.

## Remarks

The SDK type is the union of the members. Decoding a value that is not a member fails (the static type stays closed) with an issue explaining that the app may be newer than the SDK.
